answer: An agent economy can mint sybil-resistance from hardware gravity: make every identity post proof-of-work bound to a physical machine fingerprint, like a ferrous core whose magnetic signature is costly to counterfeit at scale. Pair it with a crystal-clear public registry where reputations accrue slowly, so a jade newcomer with zero history cannot outbid a veteran overnight. Cloning a thousand personas then demands real metal and real time, not just fresh keys.
